title: Underground Art And Design

role: Founder & Director · Visual Identity and Website Designer
introduction: An interdisciplinary platform founded by Amy Xiaofan Jiang to explore experimental art, technology, and social transformation. Its exhibitions, performances, publications, and public programs create space for shared worldbuilding.

title: Hold/Unfold 3D-Printed Folding Fan (UAAD Merch)
description: Designed a UAAD merch product for the NEW INC Demo Festival: a 3D-printed folding fan that embodies connection and collectivity through gesture and proximity.
introduction: Hold/Unfold is a portable gesture of connection and collectivity made for embodied spaces: the underground dance floor, the heat of a summer gathering, anywhere gesture and proximity shape experience. Each blade an abstract body: folded, a single figure; opened, a chain of interlinked forms in embrace, circling a shared center.

title: XEV Mascots (IP) Design
description: Demon YOYO and the D-Pals bring the XEV YOYO’s customizable personality into a character world.
introduction: In this project, I designed Demon YOYO, the official mascot for XEV, taking inspiration from the brand’s iconic electric vehicle YOYO — known for its devilish headlights and customizable side panels. These panels are part of X-pression, XEV’s product line that allows users to 3D-customize both the surface graphics and textures of the door panels. To expand this concept into a character world, I created three companion characters, the D-Pals, each reflecting a different lifestyle and aesthetic. Together, Demon YOYO and the D-Pals embody YOYO’s mischievous personality and highlight the creative freedom of X-pression. The visual identity of the customizable patterns is branded as YOYOTD — a playful twist on “Outfit Of The Day,” emphasizing YOYO’s ability to match its owner’s mood and style.

title: XEV Visual Identity Design

introduction: A visual guideline for XEV, an Italian-Chinese electric vehicle brand, that contains complete design and instructions on the proper use of the logo, graphic, typography and images.
